args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation steps to local setup instructions
args.body:
File: README.md

The issue highlights the absence of crucial setup instructions for running the application locally with MinIO. To solve this, an additional line should be added in step 2 or 3 to specify setting `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000`. Furthermore, it should note that users need to create a bucket in the MinIO console before uploading files. This will prevent the `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND` error and ensure smooth uploads to the local MinIO instance.
